ai.summary: The page https://mercyforanimals.org/ loaded with HTTP 200 in the headless browser. The FundraiseUp widget script loads at runtime with account ID AVGENVAN. The widget code is not in the server HTML. A site script inserts it after load, and the vendor asks for the code in the global head and confirmation in the page source. The page load event took 10.1 seconds, above the 6 second target. Four console errors were recorded, all Content Security Policy refusals of connections to two external event endpoints. The browser did not click anything. One '?form=' donate link was found. The donate page returns readable HTML without JavaScript. Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Meta Pixel were found on the page. No consent tool was detected. The checklist verdict is ready with warnings, with no blockers.

next_steps.action: Ask your web developer to add the FundraiseUp installation code to the global head of the site, so it appears in the server HTML. Then view the page source to confirm it is there.
Ask your web developer to review the page load time, which was 10.1 seconds, against the 6 second target.
Ask your web developer to review the Content Security Policy so the two external event endpoints named in the console errors are allowed, or confirm they are not needed.

customer_email.subject: Next steps for your donation page at mercyforanimals.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us to launch your online donations. Your donation page loads and the FundraiseUp widget is active. A few items need attention before we can mark the launch complete.

1. Add the FundraiseUp installation code to the global head of your website, so it appears in the page source. Please check the page source afterward to confirm it is there.

2. Ask your web developer to review page speed. The main page took about 10 seconds to finish loading. Our target is under 6 seconds.

3. Ask your web developer to review your Content Security Policy. Two external event endpoints were blocked, which caused console errors.

4. Let us know whether you use a cookie consent tool for visitors in the EU or UK.

Once these are updated, reply to this email and we will re-run the check.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
